prompt:
3(x - k) ≤ 30 - x
-14 - 3x < x + k

The number k is chosen so that the numbers x making both inequalities above true fill an interval 6 units long. That interval runs from a, which is not included, to b, which is included. Find b.

In the xy-plane, the graph of y = x^3 + 6x^2 + bx + 8, where b is a constant, is tangent to the x-axis at one point and crosses the x-axis at a different point. What is the y-coordinate of the point on the graph whose x-coordinate is 3?

At a gift shop, each box is tied with a ribbon whose length, in centimeters, is 4 times the width of the box plus 30 centimeters for the bow. One morning a clerk tied 5 small boxes, all the same width, and 3 large boxes, all the same width. Each large box is 80 millimeters wider than each small box. The clerk used ribbon from a spool that held 1,600 centimeters, and 112 centimeters of ribbon were left on the spool. How many centimeters long is the ribbon for one large box?
Let f(x) = (x - 5)^2 - 14. For exactly one value of the constant k, the equation f(|x|) = k is true for exactly three real numbers x. What is the value of f(4) - k?

A game piece starts at the origin of the xy-plane. Each jump moves the piece 2 units to the right and 2 units up, and each slide moves the piece 4 units to the right and 1 unit down. After a sequence of jumps and slides, the piece is at the point (122, 32). How many moves, jumps and slides together, did the piece make?

At an airport booth, U.S. dollars are exchanged for euros at a rate of 0.94 euro per dollar, and then a flat fee of 8 euros is subtracted from the euros. At a bank, dollars are exchanged at a rate of 0.90 euro per dollar with no fee. Kai exchanged some dollars at the booth and received 12 more euros than he would have received for the same dollars at the bank. How many euros did Kai receive at the booth?
The number of members of an online group t years after it was formed is modeled by f(t) = 400(0.64)^(-t/2). According to the model, by what percent does the number of members increase each year?
In the xy-plane, triangle ABC has vertices A(-1, 10), B(-4, 7), and C(6, -9). Point M is the midpoint of side BC. What is the slope of the line through A and M?

The functions f and g are defined by f(x) = -2x^2 - 12x - 5 and g(x) = 2x^2 + bx + c, where b and c are constants. In the xy-plane, the graphs of y = f(x) and y = g(x) have the same axis of symmetry, and the two graphs intersect at a point with x-coordinate 2. What is the y-coordinate of the vertex of the graph of y = g(x)?

(x - 3)^2 + 14(x - 3) - 15 = 0

Exactly two values of x make this equation true. Multiplying these two values together gives what number?
Long division of 9x^50 + 7x^21 - 4x^4 + 33 by the binomial x + 1 would leave a constant remainder. What number is that remainder?
Let p(x) = x^3 - 2x^2 - 2x + 2, and let q(x) = p(x - 2). Multiplying out q(x) gives a cubic x^3 + bx^2 + cx + d, where b, c, and d are constants. What is 1 + b + c?

A line in the xy-plane contains (5, 5) and (7, 10). It is turned 90 degrees about its own x-intercept, and the image is a new line. Where does the new line cross the y-axis? Give the y-coordinate of that point.
For a constant k that is less than 3, the binomial x - k divides the cubic x^3 - kx^2 + (k - 4)x - 5 with no remainder. What remainder is left when that same cubic is divided by x - 4?
In the xy-plane, lines l and m are perpendicular and intersect at the point (-5, 6). Line l has slope -2/5. What is the distance between the x-intercept of line l and the x-intercept of line m?
The average (arithmetic mean) of the numbers x and y is 6, and the average of the three numbers x, 2y, and 17 is 8. By how much does x exceed y?

In the xy-plane, the equation y - 3 = -3(x + 5) defines a line that meets the x-axis at point A. The equation y + 9 = -3(x + 2) defines a second line, which meets the y-axis at point B. What is the slope of segment AB?

A rectangular sheet of cardboard is 24 inches long and 18 inches wide. A square with side length x inches is cut from each of its four corners, and the four flaps are folded up to make an open-top box. The bottom of the box has an area of 280 square inches. What is the total area, in square inches, of the bottom and the four sides of the box?

3x - 5y = a + 4
-2x + 2y = b + 4

In the system of equations above, a and b are constants. The only ordered pair (x, y) that satisfies both equations is (a, b); that is, x = a and y = b. What is the value of ab?
For some number k other than zero, the outputs of a linear function f at the three inputs k, 2k, and 3k + 5 are -6, -3, and 6, respectively. Compute f(-4).
For a linear function f, there are two different numbers p and q for which f(p) = q and f(q) = p. Also, f(-3) + 2f(9) = 36. What is the value of f(-2)?

The function f is defined by f(x) = 3x^2 + bx + c, where b and c are constants and b > 0. In the xy-plane, the vertex of the graph of y = f(x) lies on the line y = -6x - 11, and the graph passes through the point (-2, 25). What is the value of f(1)?

Two hiking trails, A and B, share one common section that is 1.6 kilometers long; apart from that section, the trails do not overlap. Trail A is 5 kilometers longer than three times the length of trail B. Together the two trails cover 23 kilometers of path, with the shared section counted only once. How many kilometers of trail B are not shared with trail A?

At a cafe, every coffee has the same price and every muffin has the same price. A customer ordered 4 coffees and 2 muffins, but the cashier mistakenly rang up 2 coffees and 4 muffins, and the customer was charged $1.50 less than the correct amount. Another customer bought 3 coffees and 2 muffins and paid $6.25. What is the price, in dollars, of one coffee?

Let f(x) = x^2 - 8x - 7, and let g(x) = k - x for a constant k. Among all real numbers x, the composite f(g(x)) takes its smallest value at x = 11. What is the largest value that the composite g(f(x)) takes?
